The '''Ambria system''', also known as the '''Stenness system''',<ref name="DH7">[[Dark Horse Comics 7|''Dark Horse Comics'' 7]]</ref><ref name="TotJ3" /> was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Airon sector/Legends|Airon sector]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and was centered around [[Amber]] in the [[Stenness Node]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the system included [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Dark Horse Comics 7|''Dark Horse Comics'' 7]], and later [[Tales of the Jedi 3|''Tales of the Jedi'' 3]], notes that the [[Tchuukthai]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Thon]] was "[[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Watchman]] of the Stenness system." In the context of the original comic issue however, "Stenness system" is refering to the system that contains the planet Ambria.<ref name="DH7" />
